name: Quincy Morgan
original_name: モーガン・クインシー
source:
Policeman dealing with crimes concerning vampires.

Despite huge body and explosive character, he is honest and soft hearted. Cheryl is his unrequited love. Although he often cooperates with Toshirou he is jealous of him and doesn't treat him friendly.
